findings.reason: the refusal and its message belong at the grammar owner (`_split_token`/`eddb_token`), so the plan should extend that mechanism rather than fork a token rule into the writer.
findings.text: the EDDB token grammar has one owner, `_TOKEN_RE`/`_split_token`/`eddb_token` (eddb.py:70, :77, :101), whose docstring and comments state a valid token is "a series letter and digits, or a bare integer" and whose `normalised_shot` (eddb.py:90) relies on that bare form; §16 adds a second, contradicting rule in the write path ("write refuses a pulse token with no series letter") instead of extending the owner, so two places now define what a pulse token is and they disagree (the owner accepts a bare integer, §16 refuses it)

findings.reason: the plan should cite the existing threading owner and enumerate both `resolve_store_root` call sites, or the second one silently blocks the done-when.
findings.text: §16 says "the `--maps` value reaches every bundle lookup `write` makes, including the description and cache store roots" but `--maps` already reaches the cache root through `settings._store_root_from_bundle` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:179-200, which passes `search_path=maps.value` at :196), while `resolve_store_root` omits the search path at two sites the plan must fix and names only generically: `MachineMapCatalog.description_store_root_path` (machine_map.py:1230) and, load-time, `load_machine_map` (machine_map.py:1404), reached from `load_packaged_machine_map` (machine_map.py:1852); with `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH` unset the latter raises during catalog load, so §16's done-when ("`write E900001 --maps <bundle>` with `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH` unset") cannot pass with only the write-time site fixed

findings.reason: the section must account for the added refusal surface in its own text, per the interface-budget rule.
findings.text: the section adds a refusal (a bare-number pulse token is rejected before any fetch, with a message naming the full-token form), moving `refusal_families` off its current 0, and names nothing it retires or merges and gives no reason nothing can be

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §16 is a two-part correction (a token gate and a search-path thread), not a new module, and neither part spreads complexity across wrappers; the fixes extend existing owners.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16 adds a pulse-token validity rule in the write path beside the grammar owner `eddb._split_token`/`eddb_token`, which already decides what a valid EDDB token is and explicitly accepts a bare integer.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §16 adds a new refusal (a pulse token with no series letter is refused before any fetch) and names nothing it retires or merges, nor why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §16 fixes `--maps` reaching the description store root but names only one of the two call sites that omit the search path, and does not cite the threading mechanism that already exists at `settings._store_root_from_bundle`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §16 adds no new layer over existing machinery; the token gate it adds is not a wrapper but a second rule, reported under duplicate_owner.
